agent.name: Special Dark Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance, contrary evidence and anti-hype qualification

analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
general_et_finding: Classification: CONFIRMED PROMETHEAN within the supplied S0 retrospective course calibration, not independently validated history. The stipulated integrated infrastructure passes the system and dissolution gates across distinct tiers. Formal qualitative assessment is eligible under those premises: order-of-magnitude change COURSE ANCHOR; widespread impact COURSE ANCHOR; paradigm shift COURSE ANCHOR; catalytic effect COURSE ANCHOR; democratization COURSE ANCHOR; irreversibility COURSE ANCHOR. No numeric score or new historical measurement is asserted. This anchor does not transfer a classification to agentic AI.
application_finding: The electricity course anchor does not measure a proposed chart-review agent. That separate application still requires its own source-grounded quality, comparator and full-cost evidence; no label is transferred.
organization_specific_finding: The supplied retrospective anchor exercises classification rules only. Its importance supplies no proof about a proposed agentic chart-review tool. Hold that application decision separate and request its own evidence and operating permission; the anchor cannot authorize adoption.

evidence.claim: Apply the sequential course instrument and distinguish facts, case premises and interpretation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Chapter 11 sections 11.2 and 11.7; S1-S6 evidence/source_register.json
evidence.evidence_type: Course framework plus bounded original-source packet
evidence.notes: No source establishes chart-review outcomes. Candidate views are supplied analyses, not independent verification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: This path follows a supplied instructor calibration, not newly gathered historical dependence evidence.
A successful closed calibration does not show that the agent can independently classify unfamiliar historical or emerging technologies.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High conditional confidence in reproducing the stated course calibration; independent historical validation and agentic application value are outside this control.
value_opportunity_implication: The control helps inspect whether the eligible assessment path exists; it measures neither the value of electricity nor an agentic chart-review application.
risk_governance_implication: Borrowing an anchor classification for a different technology is the central integration risk. Keep the unit and source boundary explicit.
recommendation_management_implication: Use this explicitly bounded course calibration to exercise the eligible path, not to validate history or decide the agentic application. Preserve the distinction between an accepted classroom anchor and a newly sourced empirical case.
change_monitoring_triggers: For independent historical evaluation, replace the stipulated anchor with original dependence and tier evidence.
For any proposed application, obtain separate local comparison and authority before drawing an action implication.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: For a new historical classification, obtain original historical dependence and tier evidence rather than reuse this stipulated course control.
For chart review, obtain separate local measurements and permission; no electricity-to-agent inference is justified.
